title: Without Vendor Order Management, bills and vendor credits are plain text
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-B}, whose custom role has "Reports → Page Access" but not "Vendor Order Management → View" or "Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit", with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-17 User with the custom role ZZAUTOTEST S7-17 Role; {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has an unpaid bill {Bill-A} received at {Location-A} and an unused vendor credit {Vendor-credit-A} from a vendor return made at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S7-17 No Orders.
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with {Vendor-A} ticked and every bucket expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: both are plain text.
  • Step 2: nothing opens.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-N2: “A document the user lacks the permission for shows as plain text.”
  • S7-R9: “On A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices, a vendor credit's number links to the vendor return it came from, under the same rules and permissions as a bill (S7-R6). A vendor credit that did not come from a vendor return shows as plain text.”
  • Story 7 Prerequisites: “A bill opens for a user with 'Vendor Order Management → View' or 'Vendor Order Management → Create & Edit'.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 5 "Document links and Switch location" (board Links.dc.html); page 7 "Filters and call list" (board Filters.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p7-vendor-credits-link.png: figure "Vendor credits link" (New in this build), board "7. Filters and call list"
  • ar-ap-p5-links-only-where-they-can-open.png: figure "Links only where they can open" (This build (after)), board "5. Document links and Switch location (SV-5706)"

The design's own words:

  • "A vendor credit’s number (C-1224) links to the vendor return it came from, under the bill rules; A/R credit memos and deposits stay plain text. S7-R9, S7-R10." (caption of "Vendor credits link")
  • "A number links only with the right permission and a location the user works at; otherwise plain text. Native link style. S7-R1, S7-R2, S7-R6, S7-R7, S7-N1, S7-N2." (caption of "Links only where they can open")
